data.fit_policy: Each candidate is ordinary unweighted least squares with its own free intercept. linear_seasonal uses time_years plus eleven month indicators with January as baseline;quadratic_seasonal additionally includes time_squared. Calendar fields are exact deterministic encodings,not fitted seasonal outcomes. No penalty,standardization,refitting or seasonal centering using future responses is allowed.
data.forecast_protocol: Development1959-01 through1987-12,excluding only the three source-documented interpolated1964-02/03/04 observations. Heldout1988-01 through1997-12 is assessed once using the frozen fitted models. All468source observations are retained across the explicitly declared calendar/metadata partitions;the omitted training values are not treated as independent measured observations.
data.target_policy: Heldout RMSE and signed mean prediction error are in ppm;bias means prediction minus observed concentration. Report all candidates tied for smallest whole-heldout RMSE within1e-8ppm. This retrospective model comparison does not validate further extrapolation or estimate causal effects.

source_provenance.original_source: Keeling and Whorf,Scripps Institution of Oceanography,as distributed in GNU R datasets/co2.
source_provenance.units: ppm in the preliminary1997SIO manometric mole-fraction scale,as documented by R. Later Scripps recalibrations may differ;this is the frozen historical R snapshot,not current atmospheric concentration.
source_provenance.source_interpolations: R explicitly documents1964February,March,April as linear interpolation betweenJanuary andMay;those three source values are retained in interpolated_source_records and excluded from fitting.
source_provenance.export: All468original numerical observations unchanged. Calendar period,polynomial time,unit intercept,month indicators and the prespecified training/heldout partitions are deterministic benchmark analysis metadata;no fitted coefficient,prediction or evaluation score is exported.
source_provenance.license: GNU R datasets distribution,GPL-2|GPL-3;original Keeling/Whorf/Scripps provenance retained.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
